operators.name: custom_isin
semantics: Corresponds to torch.isin(elements, test_elements) with default assume_unique=False and invert=False.
Output[i] is true if elements[i] is equal to any value in test_elements.
Broadcasting: no broadcasting; output shape equals elements shape.
No bias or axes; element-wise membership test.
The comparison is performed on CUDA tensors; returns a boolean tensor of same shape as elements.
Boundary conditions: if test_elements is empty, all output values are false.
Apply torch.isin on input x (float32, shape [512,128,128]) and self.values (float32, shape [1000]).
Returns a boolean tensor same shape as x indicating membership in values.
No in-place modification of x; result is assigned to x.
Return the boolean tensor produced by the previous step.
